title: Kan Dhukkubsataa
intro: Bara dheeraa dura seenaa dhala namaa keessatti lubbuun lama aarsaa qabatanii Uumaa isaanii dura dhaabbachaa turan. Tokko fudhatama argate, tokko hin arganne. Wanti itti aanu balaa guddaa obbolaa gidduutti mudatu isa jalqabaa ta'a - gocha obsaan of qabuu fi gocha haaloo ba'uu hadhaa'aa tokko. Eenyu akkan ta'e saaxiluu dandeessaa?
clues: Ani kanan dhaladhe guyyoota jalqabaa ilmi namaa lafa kanarra jiraachuu isaati
Ani mucaa namoota lamaan jalqabaa lafa kanarra deeman keessaa tokko ture
Yeroo tokko Uumaa koo gammachiisuuf hoolota koo keessaa warra hunda caalan irraa aarsaa dhiyeesseen ture
Dhiyeessiin koo olii irraa fudhatama kan argate siʼa taʼu, aarsaan obboleessa koo garuu fudhatama dhabe
Yeroo du'aan na doorsifamu harka koo obboleessa koo irratti ol kaasuu dhiisuu filadhe
Seenaa dhala namaa hunda keessatti nama jalqabaa dogoggoraan nama biraatiin ajjeefame ta’eera

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
